rules: All holder dictionaries below are copied exactly from accepted C01 research (india.json, C01-27 and C01-40 with its reviewed amendment). Grouping them under an existing person ID does not promote dates, prove a tenure or extend an office.
Point observations are never expanded to full terms. No start or end is inferred from a successor, election, handover, death notice, farewell or "former"/"outgoing" styling; those remain claims.

Requested windows are appearance intervals from the CLAUDE-C06-INDIA-01 handoff table with exclusive ends. Where a bound comes from party_leaders.json, leadership production or the handoff rather than accepted research, the person entry says so.
Only accepted (c01_accepted) observations qualify a person here. Every Prime Minister, President and Congress-president observation is c01_integrated_pending, so those people are not in this batch.
Real history stops at 2026-09-07; every window in this batch lies before it.

Image dates describe the source photograph, never the appearance window. Every age gap and every artistic extension (standing body, hands, trousers, shoes, garment lengths) is declared in the prompt and here.

Likeness references are dated photographs of the exact person whose licence string, as stated by Commons extmetadata, matches FREE_LICENSES exactly (the OGL v1.0 reference carries the pipeline's extra grant fields). GODL-India and other government open licences not on the list, ported licences, NC/ND terms, agency or press photos, TV stills and non-free files are rejected. Original bytes and metadata stay outside Git; the repository copy is byte-identical. Nothing was cropped, edited or labelled.

Claude generates, edits and labels no image. Codex renders with its built-in image tool from the exact prompt files and input order in render-request-batch-01.md and returns the unchanged outputs; Claude then performs and records the identity, likeness, era and visual review. No review flag is true yet.
Each review batch contains at most ten people.
HTTP response header captures and error bodies that contain the client IP address or GeoIP data are never kept, copied, cited, hashed or committed.

Prompt sha256 values are over the LF bytes committed to Git (equal to `git show HEAD:<path> | sha256sum`). No .gitattributes rule covers these files yet, so a Windows checkout with core.autocrlf=true writes CRLF bytes; that hash is recorded beside each pin.
Birth dates used for age notes are general biographical knowledge with a cited source, not accepted C01 research; the registry gives a birth date only for rajnath_singh.
